corpora.basis: All 54,853 snapshot rows have year=2024 and source URLs in the official GovInfo USCODE-2024 collection. GovInfo's content metadata for that edition states 'Laws In Effect As Of Date: January 6, 2025'. This corpus evidence, not the dataset repository's 2026-08-26 commit date, establishes the cutoff. The aligned OLRC USLM release point is Public Law 118-274 dated 2025-01-06, except 118-159; M0.5B1 must retain that exception when scoring textual alignment.

Established from the pinned 2026-08-26 eCFR edition by two independent estimators that agree, replacing the earlier unresolved status. (1) Removals, a pure presence test with no text normalization: every section removed from the CFR on or before 2026-08-12 is absent from the snapshot (70 sections across titles 10, 20, 22, 33, 43, 45, 50), and every section removed on or after 2026-08-17 is still present in it (79 sections across titles 14, 15, 45, 47, 50). Title 45 straddles both dates on its own. (2) Text agreement over represented sections: agreement with the official text holds at its ~35% baseline for amendments through 2026-07-30 and collapses to 0.49% for amendments after 2026-08-12 and 0.00% after 2026-08-21, while the pre-cutoff side stays flat at 34-39% throughout, showing the ~30% text-mismatch noise is date-independent. A third check agrees: 7 of the 8 missing sections that postdate the snapshot entered the CFR on or after 2026-08-14. The cutoff therefore sits in [2026-08-12, 2026-08-17); 2026-08-12 is recorded as the latest date for which the snapshot demonstrably reflects the CFR. residual_skew_days is the 14-day gap to the 2026-08-26 oracle edition. Only 203 represented sections (0.09%) were amended in that window, so a blanket stale flag would overstate real staleness ~1000x; per-provision currency abstains until official_amendment_date is staged from the eCFR versioner. Federal Register rows remain non-composable historical documents and carry no cutoff. Two localized ETL artifacts do not follow the cutoff and are excluded from it: 24 CFR 582/583 (50 sections removed 2026-05 but retained) and 48 CFR removals of 2026-08-07 (23 of 38 retained).
